    Strict Pseudo-Out-of-Sample Taylor Rule State-Space Model Forecasting Engine

    forecast_taylor_ssm.Rd

    Generates recursive out-of-sample policy interest rate projections across rolling vintage origins using estimated Taylor rule parameters, real-time output and inflation gaps, and explicit regime-dependent zero/effective lower bound (ZLB/ELB) truncation.

    forecast_taylor_ssm(
  params_df,
  date_col = "quarter",
  master_df,
  forecast_h = 8,
  exogenous_gdp_forecast_data,
  exogenous_inf_forecast_data = fcst_df_inf,
  hp_inf_gap = FALSE,
  inf_target = 1,
  zlb_0_start = "2009 Q2",
  zlb_075_start = "2015 Q1",
  zlb_end = "2099 Q4",
  use_true_data = FALSE
)

    Arguments

    params_df

    A data frame containing optimized parameters and states across quarters (natural_rate, gamma_pi, gamma_y, phi, fitted_obs).

    date_col

    Character. Column name identifying quarterly dates in params_df. Defaults to "quarter".

    master_df

    A data frame containing historical observed macro series, including true_snb_rate.

    forecast_h

    Integer. Forecast horizon in quarters. Defaults to 8.

    exogenous_gdp_forecast_data

    Matrix or data frame containing real-time GDP projections.

    exogenous_inf_forecast_data

    Matrix or data frame containing real-time inflation projections. Defaults to fcst_df_inf.

    hp_inf_gap

    Logical. Retained for specification compatibility. Defaults to FALSE.

    inf_target

    Numeric. Central bank inflation target (\(\pi^*\)). Defaults to 1.

    zlb_0_start

    Character, Date, or yearqtr. Start date of the 0.00% lower bound regime. Defaults to "2009 Q2".

    zlb_075_start

    Character, Date, or yearqtr. Start date of the -0.75% negative interest rate regime. Defaults to "2015 Q1".

    zlb_end

    Character, Date, or yearqtr. Termination quarter of the lower bound regime. Defaults to "2099 Q4".

    use_true_data

    Logical. Retained for interface compatibility. Defaults to FALSE.

    Value

    A data frame formatted as a lower-triangular forecast matrix with target dates as rows and vintage origins as columns.

    Details

    At each quarterly vintage origin \(T\), unconstrained policy rate targets are constructed via: $$i^*_{T+h|T} = \bar{i}_{T|T} + \gamma_\pi (\hat{\pi}_{T+h|T} - \pi^*) + \gamma_y \, y^{\text{gap}}_{T+h|T}$$ Latent shadow rates are propagated with interest rate smoothing: $$s_{T+h|T} = \phi \, s_{T+h-1|T} + (1 - \phi) i^*_{T+h|T}$$ Observed rate forecasts are obtained by applying regime-specific effective lower bounds: $$\hat{\imath}_{T+h|T} = \max(\text{Floor}_t, \, s_{T+h|T})$$

    See also

    get_hp_gap, rolling_est_taylor_ssm
